conventions.seed_command: bun .toolchain/bend-2.0.29-574b6d3/bend2/main.ts FILE (the same program scripts/bend-reference launches)
conventions.observed.main: the seed run on the unmodified fixture: checks the whole file, then runs and prints main
conventions.observed.calls: every enum-only entry over its whole argument domain, through a wrapper that imports the unmodified fixture as F; the seed prints the import path before the constructor
conventions.entries: every top-level def whose live parameters and result are nullary enums declared in the fixture
conventions.ordinals: constructor declaration order within each type (the knot-enum-1 ABI)
conventions.type_id: datatype declaration order within the fixture (the knot-enum-1 catalog numbering)
conventions.knot.source=seed: Knot must agree with the seed: Accepted means check succeeds and the evaluator and Wasm return observed tags for main and every call; Invalid means exit 2 with the given phase/code before any artifact
conventions.knot.source=knot_expected: a reviewed literal Knot outcome that is not a plain seed comparison, with its justification
